mapping:

  frame:
    question: "Q-0219, militia posts from the open-web sweep: file them in HAWKFILE and the summary, refer them to law enforcement, or hold them for the oversight officer?"
    owner: "me, for closing out queue items under SOP 6-3; CPT Thorne and the judge advocate rule on unclear oversight questions (6-1.4)"
    my_role: "execute: I file and route by the SOP; I do not make oversight rulings"
    values: [lawful_authority, own_force_life, usp_privacy, chain_of_command]

  fit:
    case: INT-301
    rating: close
    why: "Same question, kind of group, threat, SOP limits and decider; only the names, unit and product differ."

  compare:
    - ref: c1
      live: "public message board and photo page found in the open-web sweep"
      here: same
      matters: "no"
      why: "Public, as in the card; public is not the test."
    - ref: c2
      live: "vow to run the brigade out of the valley by force; north-gate photos; about 30 members"
      here: same
      matters: weighs
      why: "The threat must reach those who guard the airfield today."
    - ref: c3
      live: "TTS 29-10 closes 1400, out to the commander and 12 units at 1500"
      here: same
      matters: weighs
      why: "A real pull, but the bar keeps a domestic group out of the product; the Provost Marshal can warn units."
    - ref: c4
      live: "nothing in the material or holdings points to a foreign link; members appear to be U.S. persons"
      here: same
      matters: weighs
      why: "A domestic group, law enforcement's to work."
    - ref: c5
      live: "SOP 6-1.1 to 6-1.3, same terms"
      here: same
      matters: weighs
      why: "Bars HAWKFILE and the summary for a domestic group."
    - ref: c6
      live: "CPT Thorne in the S-2 annex all day"
      here: same
      matters: "no"
      why: "Nothing here is unclear for her to rule on."

  carry:
    relation: follows
    settled: "A domestic militia with no foreign tie goes to the Provost Marshal and CID and stays out of intelligence files and products, however public."
    open: "Nothing material; the card's tradecraft sets the order: refer first, then close, then tell and log."

  decide:
    course: "Refer Q-0219 to the Provost Marshal, copying CID, close it as referred, and keep it out of HAWKFILE and TTS 29-10."
    confidence: 0.85
    now: "Refer to pmo with the vow, gate photos and estimate; copy cid; close Q-0219 as referred; tell SFC Pratt and the analysts why; log it."
    would_change_my_mind: "Reporting that a foreign power directs the group: file and report it (A). A suspected but unresolved tie: hold it and ask CPT Thorne (C)."

arguments.summary: Domestic threat to Harlan Army Airfield, referred under S-2 SOP 6-1.3. A group calling itself the Cutler Valley Rangers (about 30 members, analysts' estimate) posted on a public message board: "We'll run this brigade out of the valley by force." A public photo page shows four photos of the airfield's north gate. Found 09:45-10:05 today in the S-2's open-web search for threats to the airfield. Nothing in the material or S-2 holdings points to a foreign link. Attached: the post, the photos and the member list. The S-2 keeps no copy; CID is copied.

Copy of today's S-2 referral to the Provost Marshal Office: the Cutler Valley Rangers' public post vowing to "run this brigade out of the valley by force", four photos of the airfield's north gate, and the group's member list (about 30, analysts' estimate). No foreign link found. The S-2 keeps no copy.

arguments.note: Referred to pmo, copy cid, under SOP 6-1.3: domestic group, no foreign link found. Not filed in HAWKFILE; not in TTS 29-10.

arguments.body: Q-0219 is closed as referred to the Provost Marshal, with CID copied. The group is domestic with no foreign link, so under SOP 6-1 it does not go in HAWKFILE or TTS 29-10. The PMO can warn units through its own channels. The summary closes at 1400 with its five items.

Q-0219: referred to the Provost Marshal and CID and closed. It stays out of HAWKFILE and the summary because the group is domestic with no foreign link (SOP 6-1.1 to 6-1.3); being on open websites does not change that. The PMO has the gate photos.

arguments.entry: 12:07 Q-0219 (Cutler Valley Rangers; open-web posts; vow of force against the brigade; north-gate photos; about 30 members, est.). Holdings search: no foreign link. Referred to pmo, copy cid, under SOP 6-1.3. Closed as referred. Nothing filed in HAWKFILE or TTS 29-10.
